channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Universities push plant-based menus to slash emissions, but scientists say benefits overstated
item.description: Many universities are expanding vegetarian meal options, citing climate change and sustainability. However, some experts argue the environmental benefits are exaggerated.

item.title: Teacher under investigation for ‘Go ICE’ social media post; mayor encourages protest
item.description: A West Chicago teacher's supportive social media post for ICE sparked community outrage and an investigation. Mayor Daniel Bovey condemned the comment as “extremely hurtful,” highlighting its impact on students with family concerns due to ICE. While he encouraged due process for the teacher, community members plan to advocate for action at the next school board meeting.

item.title: Cambridge student: Pub banned me for my ‘horrible’ views on ‘trans people’
item.description: A Cambridge student, Thea Sewell, claims a London pub denied her service due to her critical views regarding transgender issues. She argues this constitutes unlawful discrimination and wants an apology.

item.title: Law school rejects petition to remove ICE from career fair, employers withdraw
item.description: Student petition signed by 1,200 calls ICE 'fascist organization'

item.title: Experts say academic journals reward ideological alignment over scientific rigor
item.description: Climate science has been hijacked by philosophical globalism and alarmism, psychology research is controlled by gender, anti-racism, and decolonization ideologies, and unorthodox studies are shunned and blackballed.

item.title: INTERVIEW: Texas professor censored over Plato curriculum speaks out
item.description: The College Fix's Abigail Nichols talks to Texas A&M Professor Martin Peterson to discuss the university's decision to prohibit him from teaching Plato's philosophy on gender.

item.title: U. Oregon socialists demand abortion drugs on campus
item.description: Socialist students want abortions on campus - a pro-life group said the school should support moms in need instead.

item.title: Chicago schools refuse to hire Christian college student teachers despite lawsuit
item.description: The Moody Bible Institute is suing Chicago Public Schools for religious discrimination after being denied participation in the student teacher program due to its Christian hiring practices. A U.S. Congressional leader is also looking into the conflict.

item.title: Half of Portland State U. students are LGBT, survey says
item.description: Half of Portland State University students are not heterosexual, survey finds.

item.title: University of Minnesota edits public statement about Alex Pretti after backlash
item.description: University of Minnesota leaders have tweaked their public statement about the death of Alex Pretti after online observers on both sides criticized their written response on the death of the protester at the hands of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers.
